headlines.text: That Saturday in 2026, it was title-change night for the AEW National Title as Mark Davis vs. Jack Perry battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.93 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. In a rematch of their Dynasty Zero Hour clash, Jack Perry retained the AEW National Championship over Mark Davis, reversing a Davis superplex attempt into a Sunset Flip Powerbomb before finishing with a Hurricanrana off the apron.

Back on this day in 2026, Darby Allin vs. PAC put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 8.47 ? an excellent showing. In a bizarre, unforgettable World Title defense held on an actual golf course, Allin and PAC brawled through sand traps and put each other through tables before Allin escaped the Brutalizer to retain.
